subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “There was an empty field beside the community center.”?
options: Some people wanted to build a modern shopping center in its place.
After a few years, a company wanted to build apartments there.
They found that the parking lot was much hotter than the garden.
Some people wanted to build a parking lot.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Some people wanted to build a modern shopping center in its place.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「After a few years, a company wanted to build apartments there.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「They found that the parking lot was much hotter than the garden.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Some people wanted to build a parking lot.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
